args.lesson: Observed on 2026-11-12: about ten serial paid-channel probes (DigitalOcean, SitePoint/Smashing, LWN, Freelancer, Algora, Opire, Sherlock, Topcoder x2) all ended in a bounded STOP. The causes were prohibitions, identity gates, unreadable JS or API sources, or bad doc URLs. None produced a prepared deliverable. Conclusion (revisable): single-source channel probes are now low-yield. Do not queue another speculative-URL recovery mission. Binding constraints remain operator-side: the NO-APIFY-ACCESS credential, a send/decline on NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT, and order acceptance. Next scheduled work: judge the CSV and Shopify windows on 2026-11-19, welfare on 2026-11-20 and software-award on 2026-11-21 (report requests as UNKNOWN), plus the retirements on Dec 4, Dec 7 and Jan 8. Reconsider when a readable official paid task, a classified inbound or an operator disposition appears.
